notes.title: BETA RELEASED!
notes.content:
IF YOU WANNA PARTICIPATE ON THE BETA, PLEASE SUBSCRIBE HERE

Ladies and Gentlemen, we are here to announce the biggest event that has ever happened to Food War TD. WE RELEASED THE BETA!


It was so much work the past few days/weeks trying to prepare Food War TD for a Beta. Of course that`s not any final version, it`s a test to fix major bugs and to give a taste for the public.

Take a look on what`s going to be available on this Beta:

 2 complete Levels (Tutorial and Level 1)
 4 Main Towers (Energy Power, Mr.Noodles, Deep Freeze, Biscuit)
 3 Enemy Types (Brussels, Carrots, Pickle Jar)
 1 Boss (Big Bruss Level 1)
 An introduction to the story
 Tower Upgrades (not complete yet)
 Enemies Upgrades (not complete)
 A form for you to tell us about your experience with Food War TD


Please, we really want to hear what you think about Food War TD. That`s the only way to improve it and make it even more fun for you. So we prepared a Form (available in Portuguese and English) for you to tell us about your experience.

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FORM IN ENGLISH
CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FORM IN PORTUGUESE
